title: Media God Fire TV
message: Fire TV 1.4.17 adds a broad compatibility decoder fallback for difficult video and audio formats while keeping Media3 hardware decoding first. It improves playback for DTS/DTS-HD, TrueHD/MLP, ALAC, FLAC, Opus/Vorbis, MPEG audio, legacy MPEG-4/DivX/Xvid/VC-1 and unusual MKV/AVI/TS combinations, with wider container detection and automatic fallback only when the normal decoder cannot play the source.
